issues.reason: The when/whenever machinery ties each derived response to its trigger occasion (every exemplar carries the During tie), and Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated restriction as widening, so a conclusion deriving fly events with no link to the cold night $x asserts (rare) flying the text restricts to that night.

gaps_confirmed: Bare 'when P, Q' whose trigger is copular over a time-denoting entity ('when a night is cold') has no defined per-occasion tie: During presumes an eventive trigger, and a rule premise may not mint a Skolem state witness.
defect_summary: A compliant form must carry the per-night restriction on the derived event; the nearest well-typed carrier is (During (sk_fly $x $y) $x), nesting each fly event in its cold night, and since the instruction set defines the During tie only for eventive triggers (the confirmed gap), the strictly licensed alternative is leaving the consequent unencoded rather than widened.
notes: The genus atom, the 0.1/0.9 'rarely' dial with its QuantifierPhrase companion, and the plain-variable copular premise are all compliant.
